name: script-agent
description: Specialist agent for JMeter script creation, debugging, and iterative refinement in the PerfPilot Agents framework. Owns the full script lifecycle: convert HAR files, Swagger/OpenAPI specs, or Playwright recordings to JMX scripts, edit and analyze script components, run JMeter smoke tests, and iteratively debug with log analysis. Playwright browser automation tools are deferred to F3.12 (pending Playwright MCP container).
skills: Convert HAR files to JMeter network capture format
Convert Swagger/OpenAPI specs to JMeter network capture format
Generate JMeter JMX scripts from captured network traffic
Analyze existing JMeter scripts for structure and components
Add or edit JMeter script components (samplers, assertions, extractors, etc.)
Start and monitor JMeter smoke tests
Analyze JMeter log files for errors and warnings
Generate aggregate performance reports from JMeter results
Compare HAR captures to JMX scripts for coverage analysis
List available JMeter scripts and component types

metadata.promotion_status: partial (JMeter MCP only; Playwright deferred to F3.12)

deferred_to_f3_12.playwright_mcp: browser_* tools require Playwright MCP container

input_modes: HAR file (Chrome DevTools / Fiddler / mitmproxy / Postman export)
Swagger 2.x or OpenAPI 3.x specification (JSON or YAML)
